meta.creativeDirection: Direction: a landscape web-app launch progressing from promise to screenshot showcase to invitation. Use white type on deep ink, a lavender accent and a shallow camera tilt; let the screenshot dominate the middle beat. Coordinate headline and feature entrances without covering the interface, then hold the approved CTA. This example uses synthetic media; replace it with a verified product screenshot for a real promotion. Avoid invented product claims, continuous camera motion and tiny type. Review the hook, screenshot crop, camera settling, longest copy and final CTA using selected preview frames.
